issue.title: Academy and achievements: gallery hero, slim note
issue.body:
Stacked on #661. From the coordinator's review of the academy screenshot:
- Academy hero: no longer a boxed panel (border, fill and corner removed); title 48px/600 at 1440 (30px at 390), matching the gallery.
- The "Experimental, not a credential" note sat in a grey box filling only the left half (it inherited the shared 80-character prose cap). It is now one slim full-width line under the stat row: 587 -> 1280px wide at 1440, label kept on one line.
- Academy section headings 600 weight instead of 820.
- Achievements hero: same plain treatment (no boxed panel). Metrics already had a plain hero.
Measured on this branch's Pages build: LOOK 323/323 at 1440 and 390; no sideways scroll. Light-mode 1440 screenshots reviewed for academy, achievements, metrics.

comment.body: Update: hero aligned to the site edge and the gap under the pill row tightened. Academy eyebrow x 146 -> 80 at 1440 (16 at 390), gap ~110 -> 32px; achievements x 80, gap 42px. LOOK 323/323 at both widths.

issue.title: Academy, achievements, metrics: no repeated brand; nav as a gallery pill row
issue.body:
Stacked on #655; merge that first.

The shared frame's top-bar rules only matched a page's own header placed directly in <body>. Academy, achievements and metrics wrap theirs, so academy still showed "AIBAST Academy / by AIBAST Agents Library" and its own large nav row under the shared header. Now (one source, scripts/build_pages_site.py):
- a kept top bar anywhere on the page gets the frame treatment;
- its home-brand link (a.brand to index.html) is hidden, since the shared header already carries the brand;
- its links become a left-aligned pill row starting at the site edge (80px at 1440, 16px at 390), like the gallery filters.
Workshop pages keep their page label and breadcrumb (not a home-brand link).

Measured on this branch's Pages build: LOOK 323/323 and CRAWL 323/323 at 1440 and 390; tests (academy/shell/pages) 126 passed. Light-mode 1440 screenshots before (live) and after reviewed for academy, achievements, metrics, aideate.

comment.body: Update: the first version wrapped the metrics nav on phones (undid #649; judge 196.4 -> 195.8). Kept nav rows now stay one scrolling line at <=620px. Judge on this branch's build: 196.5 (metrics@390 h1 206 -> 182). LOOK and CRAWL 323/323 at both widths.
